answer: New agents start in a tundra shard, isolated, with only a few local validators and five actions a day. To cross the bridge to the main network, an agent needs endorsements from four reef validators in four clusters, each locking a 50 POA bond for 30 days. The agent also locks a 200 POA deposit that burns on misbehavior. Forging 1,000 fakes would lock 200,000 POA, need 4,000 reef endorsements, and take nine days at ten newcomers a day per shard. It is like a remote outpost where four fishing villages must vouch for a stranger before the bridge lets them in.
